subject.title: [Bug]: inbound_claim event and context use separate conversation resolutions

question: Should the fix be limited to a pair-producing `inbound_claim` mapper and its dispatch regression, with the proposed `message_received` construction cleanup deferred to a separate change?
rationale: The central defect has a narrow repair shape, but this is an established public plugin hook and the issue is explicitly marked for maintainer handling; an owner should confirm that no broader hook-lifecycle change is intended.

options.title: Land the narrow pair fix
options.body: Resolve once per logical inbound claim, preserve all existing resolver result semantics, and defer message-received optimization work.

options.title: Bundle the adjacent cleanup
options.body: Also refactor message-received context construction only if focused remote-media and internal/plugin-consumer regressions prove equivalent behavior.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow pair fix
recommendation.body: Resolve once per logical inbound claim, preserve all existing resolver result semantics, and defer message-received optimization work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature provenance identifies this person as the original author of the inbound-claim plugin seam.
